title: MENU PARAGRAPHS NEVER END ON ONE WORD
why: From the 4K menu screenshots of 2026-10-08: hints and descriptions in the menus could end on one lonely word on a line of its own. The browser now evens out the last lines of every menu paragraph, so none ends on a single word. Only where the lines break moves; no text changes.
now: Menu text no longer leaves a single word alone on its last line.
